company: Cali Secretariat of Security and Justice
highlights: Built, together with the Security Observatory team, a Data Warehouse fully hosted on GCP (SILOS project) to consolidate crime, coexistence, and citizen-perception data sources.
Designed spatiotemporal risk models to anticipate incident concentration by zone and time band, feeding directly into operational planning.
Implemented a press and social media scraper with an NLP pipeline to measure security perception, feeding React dashboards used by decision-makers.
